entry.title: Climbing An Iceberg For An Extreme Cliff Dive

media:group.media:title: Climbing An Iceberg For An Extreme Cliff Dive
media:group.media:description:
Champion Cliff Diver Molly Carlson becomes the first woman to dive from an iceberg in a world-first adventure. Partnering with legendary ice climber Will Gadd, Molly trained for months ahead of the dive and learnt new skills for the challenge, including ice climbing and cold water training, before heading to the Newfoundland coast in search of the perfect free floating iceberg. 🧊

entry.title: Fastest Speed On A Skateboard (new world record!)

media:group.media:title: Fastest Speed On A Skateboard (new world record!)
media:group.media:description:
Two time downhill skateboard world champion Diego Poncelet sets a new world record for the fastest speed on a skateboard. Fulfilling a lifelong dream, he travels the world to find the best road for the attempt, and leaves no stone unturned in his pursuit of speed.
In partnership with @Prada @Porsche and @meta 🤝
⏱️ 151.83kph – Diego's @guinnessworldrecords speed 📏 2.2km – approximate length of Route des Éboulements in Canada 📐18% – the road’s maximum gradient ⚠️ 600m – length of the steep straight section 💨 10–14kph – the tailwind during his 151.83kph run 🛹 Diego rides a 9.81 Board and rolls on Seismic prototype wheels 👔 Jonathan & Fletcher aero suit ⛑️ Custom helmet and board fairing by Siegrist and Skippings
